'''CZ-4''' was a [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]] manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] and possessed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].

==Biography==
CZ-4 came under the ownership of Jabba the Hutt, and was modified to work as a watchdog, warning his master of any sign of threat from within or without the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] walls. The stress of his job regularly left CZ-4 feeling strained, and at times when not needed by Jabba he would temporarily switch himself off. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were brought before Jabba's supervisor droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] inside the palace's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] workshop, CZ-4 was resting against a wall. As C-3PO was ushered out by a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean guard]], he suddenly came face to face with the motionless, skeletal-looking CZ-4, and let out a startled wail. Later, when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] made his appearance before Jabba requesting that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] be released, CZ-4 was back up in the palace throne room.<ref name="StarWars.com Message Boards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM|quote=Yes, yes, and yes. As we saw with C-3PO in ESB, it doesn't really take that long to reassemble this type of droid no matter their state of disrepair.}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The same droid prop used for [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] was used for CZ-4 in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].
